h1: Custom Drinkware Service from Idea to Shipment
lead: Our factory team coordinates free design, product mockups, sample development and production for custom drinkware projects. Contact us by email with your product reference or idea.
html:
Make one brief serve the whole project

Combine the product, artwork, quantity, packing, destination and arrival date in the same brief. This prevents separate design and purchasing conversations from referring to different versions.

From approval to the order

Approve the artwork and sample arrangement, then record the production specification. Payment is 30% deposit and the remaining 70% before shipment; trade terms are agreed with you for the order.
